name: outer-selection-bps-vs-multinomial-v1

target.name: eight_schools_noncentered
target.priors: mu ~ N(0,5); tau ~ HalfCauchy(0,5) on log scale with Jacobian; z ~ N(0,1)

arms.bps: RunConfig::with_research_outer_orbit_selection(OuterOrbitSelection::BiasedProgressive) — the production default; outer join accepts the new subtree with min(1, W_new/W_old)
arms.multinomial: RunConfig::with_research_outer_orbit_selection(OuterOrbitSelection::ExactNormalizedMultinomial) — outer join selects the new subtree with W_new/(W_old+W_new)

seed_freshness: no occurrence of 82001-82003 in any oWALNUTS or Polyscope study, ledger, or wiki as of freeze
squared_functionals: each functional squared, evaluated on the same draws

functional_definitions.sd_theta: population standard deviation over j of theta_j (ddof=0)

work_unit: retained-phase fused target log-density/gradient calls (target_calls_total of the retained partition). oWALNUTS has no separate leapfrog counter; one fused call is one leapfrog gradient evaluation. Stated as 'ESS per target call' throughout.

diagnostics.bulk_ess: arviz 1.3 ess(method='bulk') on the 4x1000 retained functional array
diagnostics.lag1_acf: per-chain lag-1 autocorrelation of the functional, mean over chains
diagnostics.self_retention: fraction of retained transitions whose retained position is bitwise equal to the previous retained position (first retained transition excluded)
diagnostics.e_bfmi: per chain mean(diff(E)^2)/var(E) with E = initial Hamiltonian of each retained transition
diagnostics.depth_and_leaves: per-transition depth, leaves_built, target_evaluations of retained transitions

primary_estimand: geometric mean over the six unsquared functionals of [bulk ESS per target call (bps) / bulk ESS per target call (multinomial)], where per-arm bulk ESS per target call is first averaged geometrically over the three seeds
advancement_criterion: primary ratio >= 1.10 (BPS retains its status as a beneficial default) AND every safety gate holds for BPS relative to multinomial

safety_gates_for_bps_relative_to_multino.divergences: zero retained divergences and zero invalid-evaluation stops in every cell of both arms
safety_gates_for_bps_relative_to_multino.depth_cap: bps depth-cap rate minus multinomial depth-cap rate <= 0.005 (pooled over seeds and chains)

mechanism_checks: bps lag-1 ACF more negative (or less positive) than multinomial for location functionals
E-BFMI within descriptive variation between arms
interpretation_rules: This is a reverse ablation. Ratio >= 1.10 with gates means removing BPS costs efficiency and the default stands.
Ratio in (0.90, 1.10) means the outer join rule is not a material lever on this target; no source change.
Ratio <= 0.90 or a safety gate failing in BPS's disfavour is a genuine finding against the default and is reported as such; it does not by itself authorize a default change.
Cells failing health gates are reported and excluded from the primary estimand only if the failure is in both arms of the same seed; otherwise the primary estimand is reported as not evaluable.
